input_clock_limits: Frozen R4 historical member/source versions retained; no new authentication of original membership release or vendor arrival/revision times.

cutoff.post_cutoff_use: No training, validation, early stopping, state calibration, feature/selection decisions, or outcomes. Filter raw CSI300 date before any price change/rolling calculation.

features.shared_missing_summary: missing_count = number of nonfinite ordinary values /19 -0.5
features.processing: Reuse byte-hashed B2 ranked_feature_panel: current-date common-pool average percentile ranks -0.5, nonfinite ->0, Float32; no refitting preprocessing, no additional features.
features.core_score_ranking: Frozen gamma/calendar F5/W10 source and exact-integer core definitions retained. E1 models reuse the existing B2 Float32 score transformations; this does not newly certify their source PIT timing.

model.array_dtype: contiguous Float32 NumPy arrays, all features numeric
model.early_stopping_note: False already in B2/B2D; validation_fraction and stopping settings remain inactive; no random row holdout.

folds.scheme: Annual 2020–2026; all eligible B2D signal dates in previous 3 calendar years; same rows for both models.
training_conditions: year Y: Y-3 Jan1 <= signal_date <= Y-1 Dec31
both adjusted open endpoints strictly positive and finite
at least two training signal years
folds.logical_fit_time: Y Jan1 00:00:00 Asia/Shanghai, an information-time boundary, not claimed historical wall-clock training
folds.predict_time: signal-day post-close, information as of 15:00 Asia/Shanghai; actual supplier arrival unknown
folds.new_fit_receipt: Record actual run timestamp separately from logical information cutoff.

label.endpoint_join: exact frozen global calendar; never next available stock row

selection.prediction_pool: same complete frozen B2 feature rows for each model; do not screen using future labels or future trade eligibility
selection.before_label_join: Write and SHA-seal predictions and both Top20 lists before joining evaluation outcomes.
selection.primary: complete-observed mean of each fixed Top20 list; date valid only when both means finite
selection.diagnostic: same fixed Top20 lists, unavailable stock label contributes zero, denominator20; no p-values or extra claim
selection.missing_guard: Dates with zero observed outcomes cannot be silently dropped: retain calendar row, mark endpoint NA, report counts. Calendar-end immaturity is excluded by design before state gate. No reranking.

statistics.D_t: enhanced Top20 mean H3 return minus baseline Top20 mean H3 return
statistics.unit: percentage points per full H3 period
statistics.economic_claim_rule: Report magnitude and uncertainty; no claim to exclude meaningful increment without independently defensible delta.

stress.definition: After global cutoff, simple close-to-close returns without filling; trailing20 sample std ddof=1, min_periods20, unannualized.
stress.threshold: For year Y, linear .90 quantile of vol20 on trading dates from Y-3 Jan1 through Y-1 Dec31. All threshold market observations known by prior-year close; this market-history calibration does not use H3 labels and therefore does not remove final four prior-year dates.

support_gate.partition: Global evaluation calendar 2020-01-02 through 2026-08-25, sequential nonoverlapping20-date blocks anchored at first date, include final partial block; occupied means >=1 stress date. Not claimed independent clusters.

observed_support_before_any_new_model_or.threshold: linear 90th percentile of vol20 on all prior-three-calendar-year trading dates through year-1 December31; no outcome label used

stress.gate_result: FAIL_BLOCK_COVERAGE; stress mean and heterogeneity not estimable for inferential claims; do not compute their bootstrap p-values or confidence intervals.

inference.family: Holm6, three selected E1 endpoints x L20/L60; E3 closed before effects and E2 not selected, so no automatic Holm12

inference.primary_gate: >=4 evaluation years and floor(n_valid_dates/L)>=20 for each L; invalid slots retained with p_for_correction1
inference.bootstrap: Paired circular moving blocks on the complete chronological daily record, joint D and state, fixed L20/L60; entire date cross-sections collapsed only after fixed-list returns.
inference.rng: NumPy default_rng; fresh stream with same seed for each L; identical date draws across endpoints within L
inference.draw_length: ceil(T/L) uniformly drawn block starts, wrap at T, concatenate then truncate exactly T dates
inference.null_p: For estimable scalar theta: (1 + count(abs(theta_star-theta_hat)>=abs(theta_hat)))/(B+1), two-sided centered bootstrap null.
inference.pointwise_ci: 2.5% and97.5% percentile bootstrap bounds, labelled unadjusted95%; not treated as simultaneous or dual to Holm tests.
inference.familywise_ci: Optional only if frozen here: not selected; report Holm-adjusted p and clearly labelled pointwise intervals.
inference.claim_gate: positive effect plus both L20/L60 p_Holm6<.05; concordant economic interpretation; L20/L60 not independent replications
inference.conditional_scope: Conditions on these annual fitted models/predictions; no bootstrap refit. Working short-range dependence/stability assumptions, not a guarantee under structural breaks.

descriptive_only: stress support table; stress/nonstress point estimates only if distinctly labelled descriptive
stop: any source hash mismatch, key inconsistency or time-boundary violation

report positive, negative, and imprecise outcomes; old Holm960/Holm540 conclusions unchanged
